_: Single source of truth for what pages exist and how they link. scripts/check-site.mjs reads it: every declared page must exist, every required page must be declared, and no page may link to one that is not. Generated links name docs/index.html and NEVER a bare directory: CloudFront applies a default root object only at the distribution root, so /assemblejs/docs/ 404s while /assemblejs/docs/index.html is 200, and a repo check cannot tell them apart because the file exists either way.
